note: Stories cluster the last 24 hours of collector items. Summaries come only from item titles and feed summaries; open the links before citing details.

stories.headline: US launches limited 'defensive' strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island near Hormuz
stories.summary: US forces struck an Iranian coastal anti-aircraft site on Qeshm Island overnight, hours after Vance and Trump signalled diplomatic progress. US officials call the strikes limited and defensive, a response to IRGC fire on a US aircraft, not a resumption of major combat. Trump confirmed the strike and Iranian media reported explosions.
stories.turkey: Renewed US-Iran fighting around Hormuz threatens Türkiye's energy supply, regional stability and its mediation role alongside Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.

stories.headline: Trump announces end of roughly $4 billion annual US military aid to Israel
stories.summary: Trump said the US will end its annual military aid to Israel after this year, saying he agreed this with Netanyahu and describing Israel as self-sufficient. Weapons sales will continue, and he said the US would help Israel if needed. The announcement came on US midterm election day.
stories.turkey: A weakening of the US-Israel aid relationship shifts regional deterrence calculations and affects Ankara's dealings with both Washington and Israel.

stories.summary: Qatar's Foreign Ministry said both Washington and Tehran are studying Doha's proposals and remain committed to mediation. Anadolu reported the US approved a Qatar-presented draft under which Iran would make nuclear concessions for partial release of frozen assets. Qatari officials travelled to Tehran for Iran's reply, while Iranian assessments see a return to war as most likely.

stories.headline: Iranian officials say deal with US remains far; 'ball is in America's court'
stories.summary: A senior Iranian official told Reuters Tehran and Washington remain far from a deal, and Iran rejects excessive US demands. Iran delivered a response via mediators and said the ball is in the US court. Parliament speaker Qalibaf said the military is at highest readiness, and China urged restraint.
stories.turkey: Stalled talks keep the risk of renewed war on Türkiye's border and Hormuz energy flows unresolved.

stories.headline: Iran sets conditions on Hormuz and vows response 'without geographic limits'
stories.summary: Iran's security chief said Hormuz will reopen only after the US meets seven conditions. Armed forces chief Abdollahi set five principles for regional security, including sanctions relief, frozen assets and recognition of sovereignty over Hormuz. The IRGC and Qalibaf warned any new US-Israeli attack will meet a broad response, and Iran says it has a 'maximum deterrence' plan.
stories.turkey: Iranian claims of sovereignty over Hormuz and threats of regional escalation endanger Turkish trade and energy security.
